entities.summary: The Hospital Sírio-Libanês is a private hospital, located in Bela Vista neighborhood, in the city of São Paulo, Brazil. The hospital was founded by the Syrian and Lebanese community of São Paulo in 1965. It is one of the most well-known hospitals in Brazil due to the high quality of care. In 2024 it was ranked among the top 100 best hospitals in the world by a survey of specialists and patients, being the second best in Brazil.
